lines.beaver: 저기 좀 봐. 나무 위에 뭐가 있어.
lines.beaver_en: Look over there. There's something up in the tree.
lines.beaver_roman: jeogi jom bwa. namu wie mwoga isseo.
lines.learner: 소나무 나뭇가지에 둥지가 있네! 새끼도 있다면서?
lines.en: There's a nest on the pine branch! I heard there are babies too, right?
lines.roman: sonamu namutgajie dungjiga inne! saekkido itdamyeonseo?

lines.beaver: 응, 어미 새가 먹이를 물어 와.
lines.beaver_en: Yeah, the mother bird brings food.
lines.beaver_roman: eung, eomi saega meogireul mureo wa.
lines.learner: 벌레를 잡아 온다면서? 날개가 참 예쁘다.
lines.en: I heard she catches bugs, right? Her wings are so pretty.
lines.roman: beollereul jaba ondamyeonseo? nalgaega cham yeppeuda.

lines.beaver_en: Right. Butterflies and dragonflies are flying around there too.
lines.learner: 나비랑 잠자리는 꽃잎에 앉는 걸 좋아한다면서?
lines.en: I heard butterflies and dragonflies like sitting on petals, right?
lines.roman: nabirang jamjarineun kkonnipe anneun geol joahandamyeonseo?

lines.beaver: 응. 어, 이 국화는 꽃이 시들었네.
lines.beaver_en: Yeah. Oh, this chrysanthemum has withered.
lines.beaver_roman: eung. eo, i gukwaneun kkochi sideureonne.
lines.en: The stem withered too. Plants need water, right?

lines.beaver_en: Exactly. There are lots of ants on the ground.
lines.en: I heard ants carry food day and night, right?

lines.beaver_en: Yeah, they're moving that fruit too.
lines.en: They're holding a big fruit and going! Amazing.

lines.beaver_en: Huh, do you hear a sound over there?
lines.learner: 멍멍! 개가 짖네. 낯선 사람을 보면 짖는다면서?
lines.en: Woof woof! A dog's barking. They bark at strangers, right?
lines.roman: meongmeong! gaega jinne. natseon sarameul bomyeon jinneundamyeonseo?

lines.beaver_en: Right. I saw a calf at a farm last week.
lines.en: I heard calves walk right after birth, right?

lines.beaver_en: Yeah, so they say. Animals are really amazing.
lines.en: I heard whales feed milk to their babies too, right?

lines.beaver: 응, 고래도 그래. 다음엔 바다에 가 보자!
lines.beaver_en: Yes, whales do too. Let's go to the sea next time!
lines.beaver_roman: eung, goraedo geurae. daeumen badae ga boja!
lines.learner: 좋아! 오늘 동물이랑 식물을 많이 봐서 좋았어.
lines.en: Sounds good! I loved seeing so many animals and plants today.
lines.roman: joa! oneul dongmurirang singmureul mani bwaseo joasseo.
